configPanel.title: Diagram settings
configPanel.orthogonalDisabled: Orthogonal routing is only available for Arrow notation
configPanel.edgeAnchorCentreHint: Lines aim at the middle of each shape and stop on its outline, meeting it at the angle they travel
configPanel.showAttributesHint: Draw the attributes on the canvas. With this off, hovering an element lists what it owns instead
configPanel.attributeSpacingDisabled: Only applies while the attributes are hidden
configPanel.closeHiddenAttributeGapsHint: Hiding the attributes draws the diagram as tightly as one that never had any
configPanel.keepHiddenAttributeGapsHint: Every gap stays the size the shown view uses, so attributes appear and disappear without anything else moving
configPanel.snapRadiusDisabled: Enable magnetic alignment to adjust the radius
configPanel.collisionHint: A dragged shape stops where it meets another, and can still slide along it
configPanel.highlightOcclusionsHint: Shades the area where one shape sits on another, and draws back the run of any line that disappears under one. Lines that merely cross are left alone

semanticErrorMessages.WEAK_ENTITY_WRONG_CONSTRAINTS: Weak entity "{entityName}" must have total participation and a cardinality of "1" in relationship "{relationshipName}"
semanticErrorMessages.WEAK_ENTITY_HAS_NO_PKEY: Weak entity "{entityName}" has no partial key

semanticErrorMessages.RELATIONSHIP_LESS_THAN_TWO_PARTICIPATING: Relationship "{relationshipName}" has less than two participating entities
semanticErrorMessages.AGGREGATION_RELATIONSHIP_ALREADY_USED: Aggregation "{aggregationName}" encapsulates relationship "{relationshipName}", which is already used
semanticErrorMessages.AGGREGATION_INCLUDES_WEAK_ENTITY: Aggregation "{aggregationName}" encapsulates relationship "{relationshipName}", which involves weak entity "{weakEntityName}"
